test_title: PYST 33: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 22 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, P, Q and R, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only three people sit to the left of R. Only A sits to the right of C. Only three people sit between C and Q. B sits at some place to the left of P but at some place to the right of D. How many people sit between D and P?
solution: Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, P, Q and R, are sitting in a row, facing north. 1) Only three people sit to the left of R. 2) Only A sits to the right of C. 3) Only three people sit between C and Q.
